cards.answer: Karthus is an AP-focused mage who deals magic damage with delayed blasts and a persistent nearby aura. He can keep casting after death and channel an ultimate that hits enemy champions globally.
cards.counterplay: Keep moving around his blasts, leave his aura, and stay alert to his ultimate when low on health.

citations.quote: Name: Karthus. Official role tags: Mage.
Active: Karthus conjures a delayed blast at the target location that deals magic damage to all enemies within, doubled when only one target is struck.
Toggle: Karthus surrounds himself in a necrotic aura that continually deals magic damage to all nearby enemies, quickly draining his own mana.

facts.claim: deals magic damage with delayed blasts and a persistent nearby aura

citations.quote: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.

facts.claim: He can keep casting after death

citations.quote:
EFFECT RADIUS:
Global
Active: Karthus channels for a short time, then deals magic damage to all targetable enemy champions upon completion.

facts.claim: channel an ultimate that hits enemy champions globally

cards.priority_reason: Establishes his sustained damage, global threat, and continued threat after death.

cards.answer: Death Defied lets Karthus keep casting spells at no cost after dying, while he is untargetable and unable to move. If he has learned Defile, its damaging aura stays active throughout this state.
cards.counterplay: Move away from his death location and keep dodging his spells.

citations.quote: Innate: Upon dying, Karthus enters an untargetable spirit form for a few seconds that allows him to continue casting spells at no cost but without being able to move.

facts.claim: Death Defied lets Karthus keep casting spells at no cost after dying, while he is untargetable and unable to move.

citations.quote: If Defile has been learned, it will remain toggled on for Death Defied's entire duration.
Toggle: Karthus surrounds himself in a necrotic aura that continually deals magic damage to all nearby enemies, quickly draining his own mana.

facts.claim: If he has learned Defile, its damaging aura stays active throughout this state.

cards.priority_reason: Killing him does not immediately end his damage threat.

cards.answer: Lay Waste creates a delayed blast at a chosen location, dealing magic damage to enemies inside. It deals increased damage if it hits only a single target.
cards.counterplay: Keep moving to avoid the delayed blasts, especially when isolated.

citations.quote: Active: Karthus conjures a delayed blast at the target location that deals magic damage to all enemies within, doubled when only one target is struck.

facts.claim: Lay Waste creates a delayed blast at a chosen location, dealing magic damage to enemies inside.

facts.claim: It deals increased damage if it hits only a single target.

cards.priority_reason: Its delayed targeting and isolated-hit bonus shape how enemies should move.

cards.answer: Wall of Pain is passable, but enemies touching it are slowed and lose magic resistance temporarily.
cards.counterplay: Avoid touching the wall when possible; crossing it leaves you more vulnerable to magic damage.

citations.quote: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy.
Active: Karthus erects a wall of pain at the target location that lasts a few seconds, enemies that touch it suffer reduced magic resistance and become slowed for a few seconds.

facts.claim: Wall of Pain is passable, but enemies touching it are slowed and lose magic resistance temporarily.

cards.priority_reason: Its slow and resistance reduction increase his follow-up threat.

cards.answer: Defile is a toggled aura that repeatedly deals magic damage to nearby enemies while draining Karthus's mana. Its passive restores mana whenever he kills an enemy.
cards.counterplay: Move out of his aura and avoid lingering near him during fights.

citations.quote: Passive: Karthus restores mana whenever he kills an enemy.

facts.claim: Its passive restores mana whenever he kills an enemy.

cards.priority_reason: Explains the sustained danger of remaining close to him.

cards.answer: Requiem channels before dealing magic damage to all targetable enemy champions globally. Cast-inhibiting effects can interrupt the channel, but Death Defied makes Karthus immune to crowd control.
cards.counterplay: Try to interrupt his channel while he is alive; seek healing or shields when threatened.
